items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I took after Gene Austin. I liked Gene Austin.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was really a lot of pretty stuff. I took after Gene Austin. I liked Gene Austin. He was on the radio every night for half an hour. He had a high tenor voice like I had. So I used to sing a lot of his songs.
When did you start listening to him? When did you recognize him?
